name: Billy Kelleher - § 3/1
title: REPORT on gender inequalities in health, specifically as regards gender-specific conditions
part_text: ‘Highlights that inequalities in healthcare are compounded by intersectional inequalities and discrimination, including those linked to gender, age, socio-economic status, disability, race or geographical location and those experienced by people from ethnic minorities, refugee, migrant and LGBTIQ+ communities, survivors of gender-based violence and women deprived of their liberty;’
